action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup poetry run python -m http.server 8765 --directory tests/data >/tmp/httpd.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
timeout 180 poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8765/catalog.ttl > /tmp/out.jsonl 2>/tmp/run_err.log
echo "EXIT:$?"
echo "--- output lines: $(wc -l < /tmp/out.jsonl)"; head -1 /tmp/out.jsonl; echo "..."; tail -1 /tmp/out.jsonl
echo "--- stderr tail ---"; tail -3 /tmp/run_err.log
pkill -f "http.server 8765" 2>/dev/null; true
